Name: Gapless
Description: Bats are major reservoirs of emerging viruses, including severe acute respiratory syndrome-related coronaviruses, yet they exhibit remarkable tolerance to viral infections with limited clinical manifestations-a longstanding immunological paradox. Here, we generate a telomere-to-telomere (T2T) de novo genome assembly for Rhinolophus sinicus (R. sinicus), designated T2T-RSC1.0 (2.14 Gb), comprising 17 fully anchored autosomes and both sex chromosomes.
